items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: I know he's got this, it was, it sounded like a Watkins... He was good on both, but he mostly played with snare drum. He was, uh, I thought it was short fella.

ctx.x: Did he have a nickname, this, uh, Joe you're singing on?
No, uh, he was, oh, that fella's name, I know he's got this, it was, it sounded like a Watkins, but it's not what he's right name.
